map.输入线性尺寸链中各组成环的公差（可正可负），取各环公差绝对值之和得到最坏情况累积: Enter the tolerances of each link in a linear dimension chain (positive or negative) and take the sum of their absolute values to get the worst-case accumulated tolerance. This conservatively assesses assembly clearance or interference and ensures the parts still fit under extreme deviation.
map.线性尺寸链最坏累积 = 各环公差绝对值之和。: Worst-case accumulation of a linear dimension chain = sum of the absolute tolerance values.
Total tolerance = sum(|t_i|) for linear stacking. Example: three parts with ±0.05, ±0.03 and ±0.02 give a total of ±0.10 mm.
map.：最坏累积=0.12+0.05+0.08+0.03=0.280 mm，平均单环: Worst-case accumulation = 0.12 + 0.05 + 0.08 + 0.03 = 0.280 mm, averaging 0.070 mm per link. Negative tolerances enter by absolute value, so the result is the most conservative estimate.
map.最坏叠加保守，RSS（平方和根）统计更紧，按风险选。: Worst-case stacking is conservative, while RSS (root sum square) is statistically tighter; choose by risk.
map.关键配合、安全件取最坏情况。: Use the worst case for critical fits and safety-critical parts.
